paper_title: Extended Search for the Invisible Axion with the Axion Dark Matter Experiment
notes: ADMX cavity haloscope search over 2.81-3.31 ueV (frequencies ~680-790 MHz, though mass range 2.81-3.31 ueV corresponds to ~680-800 MHz). Paper excludes down to DFSZ axion-photon coupling. Exclusion is shown only in Fig. 4 with no numerical table of g_agamma vs mass provided in the text. DFSZ coupling at ~740 MHz (3.06 ueV) is approximately g_agamma ~ 4e-16 GeV^-1. Data points here are rough estimates spanning the mass range at the DFSZ level; actual per-frequency limit values are not tabulated in the paper. Local density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (MB model); N-body model used 0.63 GeV/cm^3.
